Awesome. If a minion maneuvers to depth, does that count as long
range too? I mean, unless the other minion also maneuvers to depth
and then they're at close range at depth, right?

Would have been an awesome flight mechanic, with height instead of
depth.

Will Aquaman be represented as an Aquatic Gangrel with no Protean/
Ichthometheus discipline, or a Malkavian who only *thinks* he can talk
to fish?

Can Underwater Operation be used on the same action as Dawn Op, and
does that make damage dealt at depth doubly-aggravated?

If Neptune's Trident is only usable by an Aquatic vampire, can it be
equipped by any minion and does it still grant the water-breathing
ability?

Can Gratiano's Cannon still fire at a minion who is at depth even if
the bearer is aboard a Ship? Does it matter if the ship is a schooner
or a submarine or if it's a Leviathan that counts as a Retainer/Ship?

Okay, that's all the questions I have so far. Probably more later -
the Tides mechanic is totally confusing.
